objective: Bring Parker's lunch to Guard Parker.  He patrols the road leading to Darkshire.

description: Can you do me a favor?  I've prepared a lunch for Guard Parker, but he's out on patrol...he's a big, strong Stormwind guard who can defend himself, but it's much too dangerous out there for a townsperson like me.
So if you deliver his lunch for me, then come back here and I'll give you a free lunch!  Parker patrols the stretch of road leading to Duskwood.
progress: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she? Such a kind heart she has. Well...let's have it!
completion: Thanks, I could really use the meal. Guarding Lakeshire from the orcs and gnolls is tough work!
